nla.notes: The verbalizer readouts describe semantic and domain content exclusively, with zero explicit mentions of linewrap column or character distance from newline.

ol.notes: The readouts never mention grammatical tense explicitly as a meta-label; they are natural text continuations whose finite verbs systematically reflect the past vs present tense of the context clause.

nla.notes: The verbalizer rarely mentions grammatical verb tense directly; instead, 'past' clauses elicit historical narrative/chronicle terminology while 'present' clauses elicit descriptive, encyclopedic, or inventory terminology.

nla.notes: Mentions of case ('ALL-CAPS' or 'All-caps') appear exclusively in uppercase items (~10% of uppercase readouts, 0% of lowercase readouts).
